summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Subhouz Smart Hostel Management Platform. Backend: 17/17 pytest tests passed (auth, hostels, rooms, residents, rent tracker CORE with mark-paid/undo, automation, dashboard, RBAC/scoping). Frontend: All 13 requested features verified end-to-end - homepage animated hero, Super Admin + Hostel Admin login, dashboard with all stat cards + revenue trend + payment pie + hostel breakdown, hostels/rooms/residents CRUD entry points, Rent Tracker core flow (Mark Paid -> PAID + receipt SH-202607-XXXX, Undo -> PENDING), automation workflows + trigger reminders btn, settings tabs (WhatsApp/Users/General), sidebar navigation, RBAC (hostel admin cannot see Hostels nav or add-hostel-btn, sees only own hostel's 16 residents), logout redirects to /login.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS in server.py allows single FRONTEND_URL origin only - fine for prod but could break if additional origins needed. allow_credentials=True is correctly paired with explicit origin (not wildcard) - good.
auth_routes.py /refresh sets cookie with secure=False, samesite=lax - acceptable for preview env; ensure secure=True in production HTTPS.
rent_routes.py mark-paid uses ObjectId(resident_id) without try/except - malformed ID would return 500 instead of 400. Minor edge case.
server.py inline write of /app/memory/test_credentials.md on every startup is fine for dev but should be gated behind an ENV flag before production.
seed_admin correctly re-hashes password if changed (bcrypt verify fails path) - matches playbook.
test_credentials: Super Admin: admin@subhouz.com / SubhouzAdmin@2026 (verified). Hostel Admin: jogmaya.admin@subhouz.com / hostel@123 (verified).
seed_data_creation: None - relied on backend startup seed (3 hostels, 39 residents, sample rent payments). Rent mark-paid test creates + reverts a payment record; no lingering test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Routes are NESTED under /dashboard (e.g., /dashboard/hostels, /dashboard/rent-tracker). Direct navigation to /hostels redirects to /. Use sidebar nav clicks: data-testid='nav-hostels', 'nav-rooms-&-beds' (note the '&'), 'nav-residents', 'nav-rent-tracker', 'nav-automation', 'nav-settings'. Rent Tracker testids: mark-paid-{id}, undo-paid-{id}, rent-status-{id}. Logout via data-testid='logout-btn' in DashboardLayout sidebar. WhatsApp integration is MOCKED - only logs automation events; actual message sending requires user's Meta Business API credentials.
mocked_flows: WhatsApp Business Cloud API - MOCKED. rent mark-paid triggers _trigger_challan_automation which only writes to automation_logs collection; no actual WhatsApp API call. trigger-reminders btn similarly logs events only.
